A field guide to an inhabited world · volume XIII · the elven family

Elves

Five elven monster girls: the night elf who wanders and trades after dark, the haughty high elf who builds her own settlements, the wood elf who lives alongside villagers, the blood elf of the Nether and the desert elf of the frontier towns. The most human of all the families, told apart by their long pointed ears.

Favourite food: Sweet berries and glow berries (blood elves: golden apples)

I · HarpiesII · Bullywugs & Mucus ToadsIII · NekomataIV · KitsuneV · LamiaVI · ArachneVII · CentaursVIII · MerfolkIX · SlimesX · JackalopesXI · MinotaursXII · MollusksXIII · ElvesXIV · UndeadXV · LizardfolkXVI · DragonsXVII · DevilsXVIII · BugsXIX · FloraXX · CanidsXXI · RodentsXXII · CrustaceansXXIII · MarsupialsXXIV · ArmouredXXV · ConstructsXXVI · Bats
The central similarity

People, not animals.

Elves are the one family with a society of their own: they trade, build and keep to their customs. Bonding with one is more like making a friend in a foreign town than taming an animal.

  • TradeEvery elf trades with friends (a villager-style trading screen); what she sells depends on her people.
  • CustomsEach kind has a rule: the high elves dislike outsiders, the wood elves protect villagers.
  • Long-livedElves never age past grown; their young grow up as fast as any other family's.
  • BerriesThe family food: sweet berries and glow berries. Blood elves want golden apples.

Relationships (shared by every family)

The same relationship core runs through all MonsterGirls families, from the harpies on. This volume only changes how a elve builds trust, what she gives back, and how she bears young.

AffectionEach monster girl remembers every player separately. Feeding, petting and her family's own bond action raise it; hurting her lowers it. /monstergirls bonds lists everyone nearby.
SitRight-click any monster girl with a plain stick to make her sit; again to let her get up.
Sharing a bedAt high friendship (25) she may join you in bed: once a night she decides, one in three at 25, certain at 100. Sleep through the night and she is expecting.
ExpectingA pregnancy lasts one in-game day. Her belly rounds out as it goes on (the model shows it).
Born devotedHer young are born devoted to the player who fathered them (full affection) and never share that player's bed.
PresentsAt high friendship every family brings presents of its own kind.
BondAffectionWhat it means
Wild0Keeps her distance; her species' instincts decide everything.
Curious3+Lets you come close and watches what you do.
Fond10+Follows you a little way, accepts petting, stops fleeing.
High friendship25+May join you in bed at night (one night in three, more the fonder she is) and brings presents.
Devoted60+The family's devoted perk unlocks (see each guide).
Full devotion100The most there is. Every daughter feels this for the player who fathered her.

Friendship

What builds trust

  • Sweet berries, glow berries (+1), honey (+2)
  • Trading with her (+1 per trade)
  • Defending her village

What costs trust

  • Hurting a villager near her
  • Trespassing on high elf ground
  • Hitting her

Devoted (60+)

Better prices (her trades cost one less), and she fights beside you with her people's weapon.

Mating & young

FormA single live daughter. YoungA daughter, grown in 5 days. WhereBeside her mother. Young use the adult model at 45%.

1. CourtshipAt high friendship she may share your bed. Elves are discreet about it.
2. ExpectingA day later she gives birth to one daughter.
3. UpbringingThe child stays near her mother and learns her people's trade.
4. GrownGrown in five days, devoted to her father.

Behaviour & gameplay (shared by the family)

TradingRight-click a friendly elf (fond, 10+) to trade. Night elves sell moonlit things, wood elves forest goods, blood elves Nether goods, desert elves frontier gear, high elves fine crafts.
High elf settlementsA group of high elves picks a clearing and builds an elven pavilion there, block by block, over a few days.
OutsidersHigh elves warn, then drive off strangers who come into their settlement. Friends (fond) are welcome.
Village elvesWood elves spawn near forest villages and desert elves near desert villages. Both fight raiders and zombies that threaten villagers.
Night wanderersNight elves only walk at night; by day they sit in the shade and rest.

Dark forests & taiga, at nightMysterious · wandering

Night Elf (about 1.85 blocks)

TemperamentMysterious, quiet, curious

Ecology & behaviourViolet-skinned wanderers who travel by night and trade under the stars. By day they rest in the shade.

Signature: Night traderShe only roams at night and trades moonlit goods: glowstone, ender pearls, amethyst, night vision potions, phantom membrane.

Player interactionMeet her at night; buy something.

High Elf (about 1.95 blocks)

TemperamentProud, refined, aloof

Ecology & behaviourGolden-haired and dressed in white and gold. High elves raise elegant pavilions in clearings and do not like strangers in them.

Signature: Settlement builderHer group builds an elven pavilion (quartz, birch and lanterns) block by block. Strangers inside it are warned, then attacked.

In the game

Built (2026-10-19)

  • Domovoi: befriended, the furnaces near her friend smelt twice as fast
  • Vanilla trading screen for friends (fond, 10+); +1 per trade
  • Night elves walk only by night and rest by day
  • High elves build a pavilion where their group settles, and warn then attack strangers inside it
  • Wood and desert elves spawn only around villages and shoot monsters (bow, crossbow)
  • Blood elves: fireproof, burning blade, trade for gold
  • Gifts from her people's goods
  • Valkyrie: flies; befriended, when her friend dies near her she gathers up what they drop and gives it back when they come to her
  • Brownie: tiny and nocturnal; at night, befriended, she tidies the chests near her (merging stacks) and puts loose items away; paid in milk and bread, she does not trade
  • Dark elf: sets off no sculk; a Warden near her spares her friends (and is her kin); trades echo shards and sculk

Not yet

  • Several pavilions growing into a village

Design decisions log

Decided (2026-10-19)

  • Elves trade through the vanilla trading screen.
  • Wood and desert elves only spawn near villages.

Open questions

  • Should high elf settlements grow (more than one pavilion)?
